TestTracingReadAccess::test_tracing_info.reason: Unique coverage of live sstable-read tracing until the port. Translated by scylla 4cd6f5ca73 (series merged as 42ab0bf5bd) to test/cqlpy/test_dtest.py::test_tracing_read_all_partitions (xfail, strict, on SCYLLADB-5934: single-sstable shard scan not traced; the dtest would hit it too if its check worked): same scenario with real asserts on system_traces.events, while this dtest asserts nothing. Dtest removal PR scylladb/scylla-dtest#7713 still open. No-op since 047420a3 (PR 1818, 2020-12-15); before that the 'Reading partition range' regex had no '|' and was a real check. Bug: all 3 regexes in _verify_tracing_info (cql_tracing_addition_test.py:188-191) end in unescaped '| {addr} |' -> top-level alternation with an empty alternative, so PytestRegex (re.match) always returns True; verified empirically, and independently by the scylla port 4cd6f5ca73. The test cannot fail on missing trace output; its 100% pass rate is meaningless. Note: even with '|' escaped, PytestRegex uses re.match (anchored, no DOTALL) vs old assertRegexpMatches (re.search) since pytest port fa0e7515, so a naive fix always fails. Note: d22c82e604 (PR 6887, cqlsh-rs) removed 'assert not err' from all run_cqlsh helpers; cqlsh-rs TRACING output format unverified. Note: sstable path interpolated into regex unescaped (:188-190).

TestTracingReadAccess::test_tracing_info.reason: Slowest (~34s, 3 restarts); cache-miss path after restart is the only angle the cqlpy translations (BYPASS CACHE, scylla 4cd6f5ca73) don't cover. Note: set_trace_probability(1.0) unnecessary — cqlsh 'TRACING ON' already traces the query, and is lost after restart anyway. No-op since 047420a3 (PR 1818, 2020-12-15); before that the 'Reading partition range' regex had no '|' and was a real check. Bug: all 3 regexes in _verify_tracing_info (cql_tracing_addition_test.py:188-191) end in unescaped '| {addr} |' -> top-level alternation with an empty alternative, so PytestRegex (re.match) always returns True; verified empirically, and independently by the scylla port 4cd6f5ca73. The test cannot fail on missing trace output; its 100% pass rate is meaningless. Note: even with '|' escaped, PytestRegex uses re.match (anchored, no DOTALL) vs old assertRegexpMatches (re.search) since pytest port fa0e7515, so a naive fix always fails. Note: d22c82e604 (PR 6887, cqlsh-rs) removed 'assert not err' from all run_cqlsh helpers; cqlsh-rs TRACING output format unverified. Note: sstable path interpolated into regex unescaped (:188-190).
